rationale: With only 12 minutes remaining in the session and the stock trading at the absolute top of its daily range (99.9% position), the risk of a mean-reversion fade is high, but the momentum is currently too strong to justify a short. Entering a long position at the daily high with such limited time remaining offers an unfavorable risk-to-reward ratio, as there is insufficient time for a breakout to develop or for the position to be managed effectively before the mandatory market-on-close liquidation.
